pick.headline: Georgian President Gamsakhurdia flees Tbilisi
pick.summary: On 6 January 1992 Georgia's President Zviad Gamsakhurdia fled Tbilisi after two weeks of fighting with armed opposition forces besieging his government building.
pick.significance: His ouster opened the way for Eduard Shevardnadze's return and years of civil conflict in Georgia. It was one of the first violent changes of power in the post-Soviet states.
